title: Make your key on the login page and read its fingerprint to the conductor
summary: Open the login page, make your key, and read its fingerprint (sha256: and 16 characters) to the conductor; paste the public half too (it is not secret).
closes: Your public key is in data/keys.json, added by the conductor after you read the fingerprint.
blocks: Nothing can be sealed to you, and your feedback cannot be told from anyone else's.

sources.starts: Dinis: to start now, open /account/, make the key, and read its finger
